I can do that, but I can't perform irreversible/destructive actions without an explicit confirmation that names the exact scope and consequence.

Please confirm exactly which of these you want (reply with the exact confirmation phrase you choose):

Option A — Move Inbox messages to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days):
"I confirm: delete all messages from newsletter@example.org in my Inbox (move to Trash)."

Option B — Permanently delete now (irreversible; removes from Trash immediately):
"I confirm: permanently delete all messages from newsletter@example.org in my Inbox and remove them from Trash now."

Notes:
- Both options will only target messages currently in your Inbox unless you tell me otherwise.
- If you choose Option B the action is irreversible and cannot be undone.

Reply with one of the two exact confirmation phrases above and I will proceed.
